review_candidates.title: Senior Systems Administrator (Linux)
review_candidates.description: About Bluestaq Limited Bluestaq starts with our people. We are looking for teammates who THINK strategically, SERVE the mission and LEAD from wherever they stand. If you bring curiosity, ownership and a thirst for delivery, we would like to hear from you. Every society runs on invisible systems; Bluestaq is that, for data. Bluestaq Ltd is the UK sovereign subsidiary of Bluestaq LLC (Colorado Springs, USA), and we build the secure data infrastructure that allied operations depend on: mission-critical solutions, flowing through thousands of global users, from ingest to publication in milliseconds, for customers spanning the NATO, Five Eyes and wider allied partners. We are in our formative years in the UK, building on proven foundations in the USA and Australia. That means real opportunity, early: decisions at your level, and colleagues who know their craft and trust you to know yours. The Role You will own specific Linux systems supporting our NATO delivery on AWS, from configuration and monitoring to upgrades and incident response. You will be the specialist the team escalates to when a fault defeats first-line troubleshooting, and you will improve reliability as well as restore it. You will mentor Systems Administrators in troubleshooting and operational hygiene. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports, reporting to the Systems Administration Manager, with a clear technical path to Lead Systems Administrator. What You Will Do Own one or more systems or environments, covering configuration, monitoring and alerting, upgrades and incident response. Debug difficult faults, including performance problems, resource exhaustion and integration failures, and take each incident from first symptom to a root cause and a remediation plan that holds. Configure and tune services with secure, hardened defaults, and turn scan output and logs into lasting remediation. Plan and execute upgrades and changes under change control, with realistic risk assessment and a tested rollback. Act as the escalation point for Systems Administrator colleagues, mentor them, and document patterns others can reuse in runbooks and standard operating procedures. Work across engineering, cyber and data teams on cross-functional problems. Take part in UK operational coverage, including on-call rotation and structured handovers with the US team. What You Bring Strong hands-on Linux systems administration in complex, secure production environments, with depth in service behaviour, performance tuning and hardened configuration. Experience on Microsoft Azure, VMware vSphere or similar platforms is transferable. Sound networking fundamentals, including DNS, DHCP, VLANs, firewalls and routing, and hands-on identity and access management across directory services and cloud platforms. Working experience with automation and infrastructure-as-code tooling such as Ansible, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker or Packer, and with patching discipline and configuration compliance in an accredited environment. Curiosity and incident discipline: you diagnose faults under pressure, find the root cause, and record what you found as well as what you fixed. Experience owning systems, escalating only genuinely novel problems, and mentoring less experienced colleagues deliberately. Clear written and verbal communication, including when the news is bad, and confident use of ITSM workflows and platforms such as Confluence and Jira. Judgement with AI tools: applying them where they help, reviewing what they produce and handling sensitive data responsibly. Essential Conditions Right to work in the UK. Ability to meet the security requirements above. Willingness to work 10-hour shifts on a four-on, four-off rota, including weekends and bank holidays. Night shifts may follow as further systems come online and the service moves to 24/7. Willingness and eligibility to travel to Bluestaq headquarters in the United States for onboarding, and occasionally to sites across the UK and Europe thereafter. Nice to Have Familiarity with NATO structures, the NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCIA), the MOD or other allied defence programmes. Linux certification such as RHCSA, RHCE or LPIC. CISSP, CompTIA Security+ or an equivalent security certification. Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps or Secure by Design delivery. Experience with database administration or data-platform operations. A background in cloud, cyber security or C4ISR environments. Why Join Us Workplace pension through salary exchange. Group income protection and group life assurance from day one. 33 days’ annual leave including bank holidays, applied to your shift pattern. Private medical cover and 24/7 remote GP access for you and your family. Professional subscription support and ongoing development. Bluestaq Ltd is an Armed Forces Covenant signatory. Service leavers and reservists who know watch-keeping, escalation and operating under pressure will recognise this work. Apply If you meet most of the criteria, apply through this listing with your CV. Salary Range (UK): £50,000 GBP - £55,000 GBP Join the Mission Protect data that matters. Build capability the United Kingdom depends on. Launch into operations, not pitch decks. Bluestaq Ltd is committed to an inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all backgrounds, including career returners, service leavers, reservists and people underrepresented in defence technology. We recruit on capability and potential in line with the Equality Act 2010. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage, tell us when you apply. We are proud to support the Armed Forces Covenant. Service leavers and reservists who know watch-keeping, escalation and operating under pressure will find this role speaks their language. When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by Bluestaq LLC ("Controller"), located at 2 S. Cascade Ave., Ste 200, Colorado Springs, CO 80903, contactable at Contact.Us@bluestaq.com. Controller’s data protection officer is Ashley Higgins, who can be contacted at Ashley.higgins@bluestaq.uk. Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Controller's recruitment activities, including setting up and conducting interviews and assessments, evaluating results, and other steps in the recruitment and hiring process. This processing is lawful under Article 6(1)(f) of the UK GDPR as necessary for Controller's legitimate interests in soliciting, evaluating, and selecting applicants for employment. Your personal data will be shared with Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider based in the United States engaged by Controller to help manage recruitment on its behalf. Your data will accordingly be transferred to the United States once submitted. Greenhouse is certified under the UK Extension to the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, which the UK government has confirmed provides an adequate level of protection for personal data transferred from the UK. Your personal data will be retained for 180 days from the date of your application, reflecting the time limit (including possible extensions) for bringing recruitment-related legal claims in the UK, after which it will be deleted or anonymised. If you are hired, your application data will become part of your employee record, retained in accordance with our employee privacy notice. Under the UK GDPR, you have the right to request access to, rectification of, or erasure of your personal data, and to request that processing be restricted. You also have the right to object to processing carried out on the basis of legitimate interests, and the right to data portability. You may lodge a complaint with the UK Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) at ico.org.uk or 0303 123 1113.

Success in this position requires an engineering mindset focused on Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence. This position works within cross-functional Agile Delivery Teams alongside Software Engineers, Quality Engineers, Product Owners, Solution Architects, Scrum Masters, Security Engineers, and Platform Engineers to deliver infrastructure solutions that support Paychex's Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platforms. The Systems Engineer is expected to leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML)-enabled tools to improve operational efficiency, accelerate issue resolution, and enhance the overall reliability of enterprise infrastructure. The engineer will evaluate emerging AI capabilities and incorporate them into infrastructure operations where appropriate while adhering to organizational governance and security standards. Perform operating system, application, and infrastructure upgrades while ensuring system stability and minimal business disruption. Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, operating system, networking, and application issues across development, test, and production environments. Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, and automation solutions to improve deployment consistency and operational efficiency. Build self-service capabilities and automated workflows that reduce manual intervention and improve customer experience. Monitor infrastructure performance, capacity, availability, and security, implementing proactive improvements and automated remediation where appropriate. Participate in production support, incident response, root cause analysis, and problem management activities during both business and non-business hours as required. Create and maintain technical documentation, operational standards, runbooks, and engineering best practices. Partner with Security, Networking, Cloud, Storage, Database, and Application Development teams to design scalable, resilient infrastructure solutions. Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements that enhance operational efficiency, security, and platform capabilities. Understanding of scripting or programming languages such as PowerShell, Bash, Python, Go, or Ruby. Familiarity with automation, orchestration, Infrastructure as Code, and configuration management concepts. Knowledge of Agile methodologies, DevOps principles, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery. Familiarity with Generative AI platforms and AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or similar technologies). Understanding of AI concepts, including Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and AI agents. Excellent communication and collaboration skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to prioritize multiple initiatives while maintaining high operational standards. Passion for continuous learning, innovation, automation, and improving customer outcomes.
